description: This file contains C source code implementing functions for dumping and comparing cache tree data structures in a version control system, likely Git. It defines functions for printing cache tree nodes, comparing them, and a command function to initiate dumping of a cache tree for debugging or inspection purposes.

methods.name: void dump_one(struct cache_tree * it,const char * pfx,const char * x)

methods.name: int dump_cache_tree(struct cache_tree * it,struct cache_tree * ref,const char * pfx)
methods.description: Recursively compares and dumps cache tree nodes and their references, reporting inconsistencies.

methods.description: Command function that initiates the dump of the cache tree from the repository's index, used for debugging or inspection.
